title: Playing with Gilbert Young and drummer Alvin Clements
summary: Bocage played with trumpeter Gilbert Young and lazy but fine drummer Alvin Clements; he never read but played with the best.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, I played with Gilbert. Me and a boy by the name of, uh... Alvin Clements. He died. Alvin was a... Oh, he was a nice drummer. But he was a lazy drummer. But he could love some drums.

You'd have to fuss with him all night to get him set up. And, uh... But he could play some drums. But he loved it Gilbert. You know, we'd go high Gilbert whenever he had to go play at. Well, Gilbert was a good trumpet player, a good trumpet man. And his famous number was starters. Oh, he'd rather play starters than play any number. In fact, I know that best portion of all of musicians that price they came from over the river, you see. Because a lot of them fellas, like I said, I...
